caution_findings.finding: DBAASP rows for estercin A-T and estercin A-G encode exact MIC-like concentrations, while the primary article supports only Figure 7D relative agar-diffusion symbols for those variants. These rows are source_conflict and final activity preserves the primary-source symbols.

No linked_sequence_records snapshot is present; sequence/name support is therefore anchored to article Figure 1/Figure 7/Table 1 and database literature/assay rows rather than a separate database sequence table.
Figure 7D reports qualitative relative agar-diffusion symbols, not exact MICs; final activity rows preserve those symbols and worker-4 records exact-MIC database rows for variants as source_conflict.
SYTO-9/PI dye descriptions mention DNA binding as dye behavior only; final mechanism curation does not claim nucleic-acid interaction by estercin A.
Lipid-II binding is source-supported, but final wording avoids overclaiming complete cell-wall biosynthesis inhibition kinetics or in vivo target validation.
